text: Friendly staff and good location in Paris. Great location. It’s close for several sightseeing, like Louvre and other museums Very tiny room, however the hotel make it clear when you book it
superb. awesome location, very clean and the roof top a bonus the stairs, carry our luggage’s three storeys up😭
Location, amenities Only fridge in room, no microwave
Awesome was so relaxing and comfy definitely worth it Liked everything 😁
Great facility - clean facilities, modern. Staff were friendly. Free EV charging on site, which was very helpful.
Location close to train station and view from the rooftop Sadly we received a room in the first floor without a view

Convenient, comfortable and took the worry about getting to the airport on time the next day. It was in the airport so we did not have to worry about getting there in the morning, it was clean and comfortable. Nothing to report here

Magical stay. The swimming pool is amazing. The staff is so kind and we looooved the studio, clean and beautiful. It was a really peaceful stay even being just next to the pool where children were playing! What a wonderful night we had. Thank you so much

Definitely will come back again 🌞. 🏖️ We didn’t really have high expectations because of the 2 stars. But we were stunned, and the expectations were overly pleased with good experiences. We had an amaizing few days and will definitely come back again! ✈️ The view is amaizing, great spot to observe the landong airplanes. 🌞 The owners are amiable and are really good story tellers. 🚖 They helped us organize the quad renting and taxi to the airport. The room was clean and we had daily room service. The breakfast is simple, but adequate. The street down the hotel is really crowded, and hard to see through. Some are driving really fast, be cautious.
Fabulous decor, great bar and lounge areas. Staff were great. Nothing really.
Great friendly professional staff. Great selection of food for breakfast and dinner the doormen, who let the hotel down
The location the quiet the cleaniness The hotel maid in the am she was very rude busting in the door on us.

A super apartment to make a stay in Edinburgh memorable. Arrival and check in excellent photographs sent of where to meet Mike with keys and Mike was courteous and arrived at given time Location excellent - walking distance to all sights We we’re attending daughters graduation and walked everywhere. Very central but quiet which was super! So clean and modern Beds comfortable Well equipped kitchen Toiletries provided Car parking space a real bonus in Edinburgh. We have an Audi A5 which just fitted width wise it was slightly too long but we just left garage door up and space leading to park of which u can avail as off the dreaded double yellow lines Tesco nearby for essentials 2nd bathroom Veranda overlooking Arthurs Seat was so lovely having coffee in the morning and wine in the evening Smart TV which daughters appreciated Not a huge issue but black out blinds or heavier curtains needed in bedrooms Perhaps some milk in fridge but both minor issues

Friendly and fairly priced traditional painted haveli. A great option if you're looking to stay in a traditional painted haveli but have a more modest budget! We found the staff friendly, and they were able to arrange a walking tour of the Mandawa havelis for us. Breakfast was filling, and a lunch / dinner menu was also available.
Ok value for that money. It was a bit shabby but location is good and it is ok value for the money. Also shared kitchen facilities available. A bit worn out and maybe not the cleanest place.
would absolutely recommend and stay again. staff, pool, rooms, location - everything was great

Fabulous Fabulous Fabulous. The room and decor were fabulous and the breakfast was excellent. I would have no hesitation recommending this place. We will definitely go back. Nothing could have been better. If I had to say something then it would be a little more light near the mirror but that's being extra pernickety.
Excellent. Very central accommodation clean and compact. No drying towels or cloths

Wish we could have stayed longer! The location was excellent. Just steps away from the shops, bars restaurant, pier and seafront. Gardner Street is tastefully decorated, clean and comfortable. Lots of useful information was provided before our visit and Rennie, the host, was easily contactable. For a longer stay we would have needed somewhere to hang clothes in the twin room.
GREAT. Location was great, staff was very courteous, coffee shop at the lobby area was fantastic. Breakfast options could have been improved.

Good value for money for a short stay - rooms not that spacious. Great location in the old city area close to many of the main tourist attractions. Closely many good value places to eat. Bit mean that you had to ask and pay for a bottle of water in your room
The price and the dinner was exceptional! The sheet on the bed was rough.

Charming , hospitible and accessible for the tunnel. This is a charming traditional farm with a beautifully converted out building with five rooms. Each room is tastefully done in a very French way with an excellent ensuite bathroom plenty of space and a good bed. The owner was friendly and helpful . We had access to a well equipped kitchen where we were able to cook our evening meal buying the food from a large Auchan supermarket in the village ( 3km) Breakfast was traditional French but lovely with fresh eggs cheese and croissants. The channel tunnel was 30 mins away.

all so good!))thank you Rove Expo 2020. my stay at Rove started with a meeting at the front desk where I was kindly handed the key and a guy named Moses showed me to my room and helped with luggage and things. now i have extended my stay at this lovely hotel and Moses often meeting me is always very kind and helpful and helps in any questions! I want to send him a special thank you!and I’m so happy stay here one more month!!!
Spacious, clean, bright room. Delicious breakfast, friendly staff. There is a large supermarket nearby There was no such thing, everything is fine.

Nice,Modern and on point. The Location was good and the self check in with the code and the lockbox was very easy and quick Nice design- Good shower Facility Nespresso machine with the capsules and the water bottle was on point The exposed brick design wasn't so practical, cuz it made the room and the whole building smell like concrete which i didn't care for the smell that much but it's not a deal breaker and there was no place to park around if you leave your car in the Frishman Parking lot for just one night you can end up spending up to 250₪ (70$)for parking for a short night which is Insane!
Clean rooms, friendly staff, good location The breakfast was awful. Would give a higher rating if they had a decent breakfast
Friendly staff. I reserve a room for 4 guest I do the online checking, but at the time that I arrived they don’t have the room that I reserved
Location, free parking
We booked a one-bedroom apartment. The room is pretty big and cozy. Has a smart TV. It would be nice if there are some kitchen utilities in the room.

Recommandable, even with some missing parts. Relatively central located. Very clean in total. Personal was friendly. There was no drinking water in the room. İf this is the concept, please change! Plugs, next to the bed would be bery customer-friendly
Nice and clean apartment close to the center. It provides a secure parking . Host is very nice and helpful.
Would stay again. Location Clean Good breakfast

Loved the pool and beach location, friendly staff and lovely rooms in a quiet area. Loved the pool and beach location, friendly staff and lovely rooms in a quiet area, Really enjoyed my stay and would come back again and recommend to anyone. No specific feedback, the resort is a little older but still lovely and great for the price point. I was there in the low season so it was quiet.

Exceeded my expectations. The design of the hotel is really amazing with no chance for anyone not to agree on this point especially that there are no much rooms next to each other. Very quite and very clean, every room comes with a balcony. There was hot water always and staff were very helpful. Comparing to the country standards, the hotel exceeded my expectations
This hotel near by the best beach in Phu Quoc. New, cozy. I love it so much. Breakfast was Vietnamese style and I didn’t use it. Near by a good Italian restaurant for dinner.
Very clean and bright. Good location. Extra bed in the room would be great.
Nice location, friendly staff, spacious room. They tidied up and changed towels daily.
Better waiting area. sobrang haba ng pila sa bus station delayed pa yung bus. buti n lang nakita namin to. worth it for a private CR and AC room habang naghhintay ka

A great hotel that we would stay in again and recommend to friends and family. We were in a room in the roof with a dor. It's a very elegant hotel, central, with parking close by and a valet service There was nothing I didn't like

The hostel was extremely clean and had a good vibe. The staff was too kind and extremely helpful. I would suggest anyone who's looking for something in budget and extremely close to the coast. That's the best part about it.
Wonderful! Highly recommend. Very clean. Nice location. Food.
Make me feel comfortable will all the facilities . Toilet was very clean . Hv security guard , feel safe . Since i bring my 6 months old baby here , everything was affordable 👍🏻

Perfect place to stay. It was a fantastic place to stay. The hosts were so friendly , knowledgeable and were so accommodating. Would recommend this guest house to everyone. The pool was clean used it everyday. Clean room comfortable bed and excellent breakfast. Nothing. It was perfect

Good hotel good location. Good room, breakfast was good. Location a 15-20 minute walk to the royal mile. Parking good, a bit expensive but it is a city hotel. Easy to find. Rooms clean facilities good.

Stunning hotel, gorgeous surroundings, I highly recommend staying here. The staff were absolutely amazing and wonderfully accommodating. The hotel is really beautiful and comfortable, you have a lot of space to yourself and although the breakfast isn’t hot, it is very filling, you could probably spread it across breakfast and lunch. There is a skylight over the bed that makes sleeping difficult if you like to sleep in complete darkness. It is a lovely feature but not practical for sleeping purposes, although I know some people like to wake up with the sun. The pool is wonderful too.

Top hotel but no need to take the loft suite. We stayed in the loft suite. This are too big rooms. It was a good setting with our kids. The design of the hotel is unique and nice. We also liked the fact with this arragement you can drink any time drinks for free at the bar. Also a good fact is the point having a good restaurant and spa (extra fee) in the same building. The breakfast is super but sometimes at the weekend in the rush hour (9-10 am) quite crowded. There is no need to take the loft suite. The room is big but lacks some comfort. A table or a better layout of the bath room would be nice. The sink is directly in front of the toilet. Also the shower is very small. For a premium suite the arrengement it is missing some details as an umbrella or a small desk to write. In the night noise from the other room above or the fitness was very loud. In the morning the construction site next to the hotel started early. Nothing special for a city hotel, but to be taken in to consideration. As a conclusion I recommend to stay the hotel in a normal room then it is going to be perfect.
terrace and size of bathroom kitchenette Elevator was very small--for families with luggage and waiting time. Did not seem to have many room lights

Excellent location, clean rooms with nice amenities at a great price! The rooms are updated and clean. comes with the amenities you need. awesome screened in back porch. very private. location is everything. parking lot is a little tight if you have a large vehicle. no free breakfast. city made them get rid of the hot tub. it was super nice when they had it. I hate that it’s gone. from 10 pm-1 am all we heard was slamming doors. car doors, room doors, stuff inside rooms banged around. it seemed like a ton of people showed up at those times which is odd because check-in was already closed. the noise kept us awake til around 2 am.
Lovely grounds. Free airport shuttle. free airport shuttle. lovely grounds.

As classy and beautiful as the city. Friendly welcome, spacious room and bathroom, comfortable bed, beautiful design, art and wooden floors. We would have to come back to try the breakfast. A bit pricy, probably due to the holidays

Very good starting point for visiting Amsterdam. Ideally located close to the centre, the Leidesplein and its shops, museums, Vondel Park and the tramway with car parks nearby. Friendly staff. Complete & Good breakfast Automatic check-in & out (with help if needed) Minor minuses : Large bathroom but separate washbasin not very practical No shower gel available
I might come back to this hotel, but may be in the autumn… Reasonable price, close to the Metro and very welcoming staff. Everything was fine, except the missing of an air conditioner!
Very good stay in this very well located hotel. Cleanliness and welcome as expected. Kristina's professionalism and courtesy are greatly appreciated.
It’s very clean, nicely organised & affordable The water heater didn’t get hot and the wifi was slow.

Great choice. Lovely renovated room in a great location. We are a couple travelling with our adult son - the room design was perfect. Exceptional breakfast (better than many 5 star hotels I’ve stayed in) overseen by an ebullient and attentive host - highly recommended.
Great location, staff were excellent , facilities great. Couldn't fault it.

confortable and practical stay close to beach and on the way to airport - valued the soundproofing. soundproof! nice decor and swimming pool location is away from the beach but only a five minute walk

Quiet oasis in the city centre. Nice and cosy place with a great owner. It's in the city centre, but the rooms are absolutely quiet as they are in the back and look onto green patios. The room itself was very good and clean, especially very modern shower. It was a maisonette with steep stairs which was nice for me, but maybe not for everyone. The breakfast is also fantastic, especially the real Italian coffee. The tram which leads to the bus terminal and airport is around the corner.
Excellent for bus. Great location for late arrival on bus. Room was clean, large and comfortable.
Execellent stay and very accommodating staff! Plenty of space and a full service kitchen
Good service, staffs are friendly, helpful, the room is spacious and clean.

The location was perfect for our needs being just outside of town in a gorgeous rural setting. The proprietors provided a lovely, filling breakfast with hot and cold options made to order, including vegan items. They graciously accommodated our dietary needs. The property was beautiful and comfortable. We wish we had been able to stay more than the one night. 100% I would stay here again.
Better than we expected for the price. location close to Auckland airport, clean property. small kitchen
Very convenient to travel everywhere from shopping mall to nearby street foods stalls. They had only one charging point inside the hotel room. Otherwise all good
Good except for noise. Excellent location in front of beautiful and safe beach. Too noisy. Music until 3am. Small room but neat.

Friendly budget hotel in a super location. The rooms were basic and sufficient for a family stay. Our room faced the car park at the back of the hotel and we weren't bothered by noise. The lounge facilities were adequate for us to gather as a family of 5. We appreciated the staff allowing us to watch a football match on the TV. The rooms were cleaned to a high standard and had comfortable beds. The hotel has a brilliant location, with a supermarket next door, the main street has plenty of shops and restaurants of all varieties. It is also easy to reach Butte De Lion. Train links to Brussels are frequent and simple to use. Our main reason for choosing this hotel was it's proximity to Walibi and Aqualibi (the theme and water park in Wavre - great fun for the family) which were less than 30 minutes drive away. (Hotels in that area were more expensive). Overall, it is a friendly budget hotel which provides a good night's rest. Ventilation in the bathroom for showering. No lock on the bathroom door. Price for breakfast was too expensive, so we didn't use that facility at all.
We booked 2 rooms they where clean and tidy and value for money. Hotel was looking very tired and needs a spruce up .
It’s new. Large area in the room. Good location that near the station and shopping area. Shower liquid
Beautiful place and location breakfast good a little sparse No elevator but seems this is common we were asked if we needed help getting luggage up stairs
Handy for north terminal. Great location for north terminal. Bed and pillows very comfortable. Nice buffet breakfast. Restaurant service for dinner was slow. Bathroom very compact.
Beautiful hotel in a great location. Brautiful design, lovely staff, amazing location, clean. Walls a bit too thin. No fridge (or tv).

One Day Stay at Magnet Hotel. The rooms were very clean and the property was well maintained. The in house restaurant on the first floor had very good quality food and service was excellent. Overall a wonderful stay.

Very nice property- newly built to high finish and good décor- beautiful morning light, in a quiet residential area walking distance to the sea. Fantastic host- very welcoming who is also welcoming of feedback. I arrived under complicated circumstances for family emergency and the host was super attentive and flexible. She really helped us allay the logistical aspects of otherwise complicated situation- with a warm smile and many attentions. Highly recommended. As a new build- the accommodation still has some tweaks to adjust and resolve, but Katica is visibly invested in making improvements all along the way - which is important. Would be great to have some off-grid solution to the electricity mayhem in SA- like a battery.
Wonderful Stay in Rome. Everything was amazing. Next to Metro, quiet neighborhood, clean room. Elena is a great host. She helped me a lot with my stay.

Spacious rooms, good location near metro station, very kind receptionists, good breakfast Cleanliness should be improved, there were some stains on the bedsheets, door of the bathroom cannot close and when you try to close them as much as you can they get a little bit stuck, the bathroom is flooded after the shower
Clean and ideal location. Clean and great location The lift and matress uncomfortable
Excellent hotel for the value, with a hot tub and pool, and a great free breakfast! Hot tub, pool, king size beds, quiet Location is a bit of a dead zone
It was cheap and the bed was comfortable. We found a few cockroaches in the room and there was not enough soap in the bathroom for a single shower.
Lovely apartment in the heart of the city. Perfect location, clean apartment. Wifi connection was pretty bad.

My amazing stay at Paskins Farm was incredible. The farm was amazing. Cath and John were incredible and so very friendly. The goats were my favourite. The horses roaming around the property and coming up to say hello were a treat. The fresh free range eggs from the rchickens were delicious. I would go back in a heartbeat. They are having trouble with their WiFi, but as I said, most people have data they can use. Anyway, who needs the internet when you can just sit in the sunshine and watch the animals. There was nothing. Everything was perfect.
The best handy location from Fukui Station. Public bath, location & breakfast

Comfortable, clean, convenient, friendly staff and cute decor. This is a very cute property, they've done a swanky mix of NM dessert chic decor. It was a no frills, comfortable, clean hotel with a convenient location for our purpose. The staff was really nice and serviceable.

Comfortable and functional for our needs, but probably wouldn’t stay here again. Good location, within walking distance of places of interest and eateries. Comfortable bed and modern bathroom Poor breakfast, not value for money! Aircon not functional for entire stay and nothing done about it, even when we complained twice. The fact that manager was never present to fix problems and bar staff didn’t have any authority to do so on his behalf. This place needs to decide wether it’s a bar or a hotel, as at present hotel customers seem to be an afterthought. Bar staff although very welcoming and helpful told us that they are frustrated at having to field customers complaints because manager is never on site.

does the job. I’ve been staying here for a while. I was given a newly refurbished room a few weeks back & it was lovely. more plug sockets, bigger tea cups, coffee bags, bigger TV, nice toiletries and much improved decor. the last twice I have been put in the old rooms (despite having paid £40 extra) and they in comparison they really aren’t worth the money. I was told I didn’t pay enough to get a newly refurbished room, but I have paid more the last 2 weeks, so that argument doesn’t stack up. the bath tap didn’t work well in my room this week and there was mould on the ceiling. I mean it does the job, but there is a notably marked difference with the upgraded rooms, yet lack of clarity over how those are allocated (clue - it’s not on price paid!)

Clean, modern property and a really perfect location to visit London. Some great restaurants nearby too! Fantastic location, clean and well kept property, recommend and will definitely stay again when visiting London The wifi dropped out a few times and was a bit unreliable but we didn’t really need it as we were outside the hotel except for shower and sleep

Quaint old world pub in a beautiful picture postcard English village. Brilliant staff, very helpful. Breakfast was standard fare for an english breakfast. Dinner was superb, plenty of choice, well cooked and well presented. Room was on the small side and quite dark but perfectly ok for our stay Hotel was full on our first night, we would have preferred a larger room but none available. Equally, a walk in shower was not available.

Excellent place to stay, the hosts are amazing people. Very helpful, full of good useful information, easy to get on with and very interesting as well. The place was clean and very comfortable, easy to find, food was lovely and the bar had everything we needed.
great! Ameeeei! highly recommend. near from bus station. nice terrace, clean and the manager was awesome! 🥳
Great experience. Staff was amazing! Very pleasant very easy check in and out. Room was very clean and comfortable.

Great apartment in the perfect location! The apartment was very well facilitated and super close to Korcula old town. Additionally, check in and check out was very smooth and the host was lovely. Very good value for money!

even close to the airport it was pretty quiet. like the dove products provided. saw a couple of roaches, one didn't survive. not enough pillows. 0 on one bed. 4 on the other. made due with what we had.

Definitely would stay there again! The room was clean and the staff was wonderful!. A great value for the price. They need an update in the lobby and hallways but it is an insignificant inconvenience and to be expected.
Breakfast, position, beds. Toilette, cleanliness.
Sincerely. third time staying at this hotel and it's love! incredible view from the room, nice staff, sincere breakfasts, the softest blankets and pillows :) I rest my best in this place

I chose it for location, disappointed with hotel for the cost. Staff were extremely nice and helpful. Especially the bar and breakfast staff. The hotel seems "tired". The bar area was extremely ordinary and like a canteen. Furniture unexciting. Breakfast room, another canteen. Breakfast food containers at hot section were so obviously very old, handles broken, paint chipped. Bacon overcooked and scrambled egg watery and very pale. The heating was not working in the bar area and as there was a severe weather storm outside it added to the dreary feel. Paint on the fire doors chipped and peeling, paint on my bathroom door chipped and marked. As it is the start of the new season I would have thought all these things would have been part of the winter renovations. The duvet was very thin and pillows poor. For the price I expected a nice full duvet, better quality pillows and better furnishings generally. This is a Radisson after all and I have stayed in many throughout Europe.
Acceptable. Breakfast was good The dust in the room

A perfect stay in a lovely area. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. Loved the location - 3 pubs that do food and shops for groceries only a minute walk away and only a short walk down to the lake shore. We particularly liked having the space of self catering but having breakfast included at the B and B owned by the same owner , Frances. The breakfast was well cooked, presented well and very hot. Nothing.

I have stayed here a few times now can not fault the hotel staff where very helpful clean room lovely breakfast all that you want good value for money to I would recommend this hotel There was nothing there to dislike
Great location close to mall , Vodafone event center, everything within walking distance was fantastic would definitely stay again 😀

Kozi so cosy. The bed was really nice. Cleanliness, 5 stars. Proximity to JKIA is perfect and cost is pocket friendly. I definitely recommend this facility The room had the smell of fresh paint. There was no phone in my room meaning if I needed anything, I had to go all the way to the reception which wasn't easy after traveling all day.
The room is clean and bathroom is well functioned with a bathtub included. The small patio in front of the room makes it very comfortable and relaxing. Very good choice for the amount we paid.
Good location, good money. Location amd value for money AC was broken/ so noisy. Bathroom sink tap was not usable.
a hidden gem close to many attractions. Good location, clean, nice staff.

Location wise - close to the mall. The room is spacious!, with a strong water flow (excellent!). Well-equipped kitchen (good enough to cook a simple meal). AC is pretty good too. Nothing. - just a bit confusing to find a place. But the owner will guide you. Super helpful. By the way, I wish extra pillows would be great
Great location Chris great host and very helpful
Great location, good breakfast. Excellent breakfast and central location. Within walking distance of the station, Old Town and many museums. Rooms were clean. I found the bed far too soft.
Great stay. Breakfast was good and well presented. Location is nice for a nice a relaxation time. All was great.

Perfect location, very close to the train station and downtown. The apartment is modern, clean, well-equipped, comfortable. Excellent breakfast, helpful host. Impeccable service! Unfortunately the house and the square are very noisy. The upper neighbour walked around in high heels every night for hours.

ok for 1 night with small luggage. Then risk of claustrophobia. a very tiny single bed room, but lot of natural light and very clean; space problem well adressed Far too pricy for super small room. Was forced to reserve as other hotel did not honor reservation and needed same day room.
I was on transit and stayed one night in the hotel, the free shuttle is convenient. The location is bad, however the hotel provides great service, free shuttle bus. , which compensate it

Good value and comfy. Location was perfect. Walking distance to train station and town , reception staff was friendly and polite Simple Breakfast was nice and sufficient to start the day. But I would to suggest that they don't serve the same cake everyday, cos after two days you just don't want to eat the cake anymore. Should try to serve toast or boiled eggs instead. Plain croissant was nice and fresh and many jam options to spread on it . Breakfast can be improved by not serving the same flavour cake everyday. After two days. You don't want to eat anymore. Suggestions: Maybe change the flavour alternate day or served boiled eggs or other flavour pastry instead.

Pleasant. Didn't have breakfast but the location was excellent Well I was charged incidental credit card authorization of 150 dollars which I haven't been refunded and emailed them about the matter but they didn't reply to me.

perfect ryokan. As an American, it was the exact experience I was looking for: tatami floor mats, comfy beds, bento box breakfast, no TV and it was a gorgeous simplistic balance of modern in the bathrooms with AC. Super central to Nishiki Market and easy walking to delish restaurants and Fab Dept stores. For my 6ft tall teenage boys the ceilings are LOW so they had to get used to not hitting their heads on the door thresholds. Mildew smell in closets so we did not use but that is due to the types of old buildings and very common to Ryokan in general. Unless you have big health concerns, was not a deterrent

over all it was great and very confortable💥. love the bunk beds the the kids and it was super confortable and only 9 mins away from Disney that there wasn’t really hot water had to wait for the hot water a least 3 mins
10 minutes by walk from the centre. Good breakfast, room is warm and comfortable. 👍🏻

Great stay. I was a little worried reading the reviews after I had booked but I am so glad I stuck with my plans to stay there. My room was clean, the staff was super friendly and the restaurant was fantastic. The hotel could use some updates but for the price and location I can't complain. If given the chance I would stay there again.

Perfect! Beautiful location, welcoming, comfortable and cozy! Everything was thought of and on point. On the River. beautiful picturesque surrounded by nature. I must say it far exceeded our expectations! The cottage was clean, perfectly prepared, excellent friendly service, went above and beyond. from making sure we had the bv correct directions, to heating the cottage, had the fireplace ready and Jacuzzi warm. Really nothing comes to mind! suggestions: I’d add a braai tong in the kitchen and back up Matches if the lighter may glitch.
Great value and big welcome. Super value small room, much better than I expected. Very welcoming. Reminds me that small guest houses like this are much better quality than hotels.
Small room and small bathroom but the place is great really. Good staff, good location. Worth every penny we paid!

Underwhelming. Friendly and helpful staff. Central location. Underwhelming rooms. Lacked staples like a kettle and bottled water. The hotel is in serious need of an overhaul. The room's bright white LED lights made it feel like an office space. Not worth the price I paid.
Welcoming staff, easy access to the place. Room by itself was very clean and warm, perfect for the colder weather. Nice view of the mountains.

It was quiet and comfortable, maybe even too quiet in the bar but enjoyed it overall except the egg! I think a lot of thought has been given to lay out of room, lots of lighting which I like and good mirror and a picture on wall and little table and chair all made it inviting. I needed somewhere calm as I was visiting my sick husband. My sons shaver ran out of power and unfortunately there wasn't a two pin adaptor to be seen. normally take adaptors when going abroad. thought the bar was a bit pricey. a large glass of merlot and pint of cider came to 17 pound!

Very nice stay, great location! Breakfast was a very good option too. Helpful personel. Room was tiny but enough for two people. Big plus for TV with YT option, radio. Kettle available. We are very satisfied with our stay. Nothing to mention

Wonderful family Jerusalem trip. Beautiful feeling and very charming bespoke amenities and beautiful appeal. The jacuzzi on the balcony was such a great hot with our family. Everything was nice. Breakfast one day was a bit of debacle but they were kind. Yousef very nice

Best hospitality ever! Best Riad ever! Everything was nice. Great location, beautiful surrounding atmosphere. The room was spacious and clean. Abdul was very polite and helpful. He pretty much gave me a list of Dos and Don'ts while I was in Fes. I highly recommend and I would surely choose it again next time I visit Fes.

Excellent. Hotel was comfortable and clean. Staff were very kind and render excellent customer service. Breakfast was excellent it catered my needs as I don't do dairy product and to my suprised I had variety of choice. It was easy to travel around by just walking. Definitely should I return to Edinburgh this will be my go to hotel Walking around which was comfortable for 10 years old. Sightseeing was easily accessible.

nice looking hotel for the price. Room was nice and spacious breakfast was okay no cot bed given not 5 stars standard for cleanliness location is not as close to the mosque. or food places. annoying lifts that take ages. some of the staff, service boys were being flirty
The place was really good. Very well located, close to all touristic places in Barcelona.
Staff amazing! Sergei from the night shift is the man! really nice location, you can walk anywhere and good places to hang at night.
Really cool historic hotel in a great downtown location.
The rooms were nice and clean. We have been on a road trip and stayed in several hotels/motels and the beds were the most comfortable ones we have stayed in. The staff was very nice.
Food was good, value was good. The lawn in the back needed maintenance and the ocean view was blocked

Very helpful staff and a convenient location - perfect for a weekend in Milan. The staff were very accommodating to us considering we knew very little Italian - everything throughout the stay was made clear by the staff at reception, the janitors did a very good job with cleaning the room, and staff members also recommended a very nice local restaurant for us on our first night. The hotel is close by to the metro which made getting around Milan easy. The beds were surprisingly comfy (single bed) and the curtains blocked out the light well. There were often young adults loitering around the area and the tram seems to run at night which sometimes made getting to sleep a little more difficult. The hotel seems to be linked to the Novotel next door (i.e. staff seem to wonder between the two buildings) but this connection wasn't really explained to us during our stay.

Ok. Standard room delivered very comfortable bed and shower room - all that was needed for a one night stay due to early flight next day. On the downside lighting in room was poor and could have done with at least one shelf to put things on rather than have to leave on the floor. Was Ok for one person but with 2 it would have been a pain. Was expensive for what you got but then it was inside the terminal so didn’t have to bother with taxi/bus transfer to airport on the day. Lighting in room and more storage space

Staff very helpful and attentive. Room was very spacious and comfortable. location is great very close to airport and they offer free shuttle from to hotel to the airport wifi in rooms is poor but is great in lobby
Gud. Value for money! Location Room size Not a 4 star rating Low on luxury

We were there with small children and it was super - the kids pool, the beach, the playground, everything was great for kids.we liked the kids dance show which was in the evening, but it would be nice if it would be every night and maybe last longer.animator was great, so positive and bright, we loved her :) The pool bar was cool, but maybe some fresh juices could be added to the menu, so the people who don't drink alcohol or commercial juices could also freshen up (with something other than water :). Generaly, we had a great vacation, we enjoyed it and would gladly repeat it :D The worst thing during our stay, and the reason I gave this whole experience a grade 9 instead of 10 is TERRIBLE Wifi.the worst signal was in our room - we would try to locate and connect to it for a couple of minutes just to have it connected for a couple of seconds.then it would get lost and you would have to go through the procedure again and again during our entire stay.we couldn't exchange a couple of messages without getting frustrated.during the night we couldn't even see the network. Wifi was perfect on the beach, and around the pool area and the restaurant depending on the location - somewhere ok, somewhere poor.also, when a lot of people came, towards the end of our stay, wifi got dramatically worse. Some other things that could be enhanced are: - more variety of meals, so they are not almost the same everyday - some fresh juices at the bar - more shows for kids and it would be nice if they would be every night All in all, wifi is the only thing that was dissapointing, and everything else could maybe be better, but it is not the reason to have any negative thoughts about our stay :)

Although most staff were helpful - one was rude.

The location is convenient. It is very convenient to walk to Times Square or Central Park. Restaurants and supermarkets. Functional, Ok place to stay for a few days. Convenient location just off the freeway easy entry and exit. Free parking was a big plus, usually the other hotels in the downtown charge about $40-$60 per night for parking. Shower had very good force of water, the parking lot was lit up, basic breakfast was provided. Special thanks for the all-day coffee provided at the lobby. The cleaning lady did an outstanding job, flawless. The chair in the room 117 was so old and dirty that we could not use it. The hotel, generally needs a renovation, it look like a run-down, sad place. Quite some noise from the highway (more on the upper floors) and a lot of home less people in the gas station area outside the hotel (but there was none inside the hotel premises). The management may consider adding bread and water to the breakfast menu, those are really basic :)
